FOREWORD This Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after the draft finalized by the Pesticides Sectional Committee had been approved by the Food and Agriculture Division Council. Triazophos, Technical Concentrate is an insecticide used in the formulations meant for agricultural purposes, Triazophos is the accepted common name by the International Organization for Standardization for 0,0 Diethyl0-1, Phenyl 1,2,4 -triazol-3y1 phosphorothioate. The emperical and structural formula and the molecular weight of triazophos are as follows:
Empet-ical Formula Structural Formula Molecular Weight

313.3

In the preparation of this standard, due consideration has been given to the provisions of the Insecticides Actr 1968 and the Rules framed thereunder. However this standard is subject to restrictions imposed under the Act and Rules wherever applicable. For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS 2: 1960 `Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised)'. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

ANNEX A [ Table 1, S1 No. (i) ]
DETERMINATIONOF TRIAZOPHOS CONTENT

A-1 GENERAL HPLC method shall be used for estimating Triazophos content. A-2 HIGH PERFORMANCE LIQUID CHROMATOGRAPHY A-2.1 Principle A High Performance Liquid Chromatography( HPLC ) unit with a ultraviolet ( UV ) detector is used for determination. A solution containing known amount of Triazophos standard and solution containing known mass of Triazophos sample is injected to obtain respect ive peak areas. The percentage of Triazophos in sample then computed by standard relationship. A-2.2 Apparatus A-2.2.1 HPLC Unit -- A suitable instrument equipped with a UV detector and a printer plotter-cum-integrator. The HPLC conditions suggested below can be changed in equipment employed, provided standardization is done:
Column -- Stainless steel 25 cm long, 4.6 mm id. packed with silica particle size 5 p (make E merek or waters). Detector -- Ultraviolet. Wavelength -- 254 nm. Flowrate -- 2.0 ml/min. Sample size -- 20 pL

A-2.3.6 Mobile Phase Mix iso-Octane, 1,4 Dioxane ( before mixingthe solvent, add 0.15 percent water in 1,4 Dioxane ) in the ratio of 90:10. A-2.3.7 Triazophos reference standard of known purity ( A standard of 60 percent LC with known active ingredient content only be used ). A-2.4 Procedure A-2.4. 1 Preparation
of Standard Solution

Weigh accurately standard to contain 110 mg of active ingredient in 50-ml volumetric flask. Add 10 ml of Toluene and dissolve it and make volume up to the mark with make up phase ( A-2.3.5 ). Take out 5 ml of this solution with pipette into another 25-ml volumetric flask and make up to the mark with make up phase ( A-2.3.5). A-2.4.2
Preparation of Sample Solution

Weigh accurately sample to contain 110 mg of Triazophos active ingredient in 50-ml volumetric flask. Add 10 ml of Toluene and dissolve it and make up to the mark with make up phase ( A-2.3.5 ). Take out 5 ml of this solution with pipette into another 25-ml volumetric flask and make up to the mark with make up ,phase ( A-2.3.5 ). A-2.4.3 Estimation Inject 20@ of standard solution into HPLC unit peak area oftwo successive injections agree within 1 percent. Then inject 20 pl of sample solution into HPLC unit to obtain the pack area. A-2.4.4 Calculation
